chunks: Allah distinguished you with Islam and chose you for it, and this is because it is the name of safety and the collection of honour.
Allah the Exalted chose its way and disclosed its proofs, from the apparent knowledge and the inner wisdom, its wonders are not exhausted and its marvels do not end.
It contains blossoming bounties and lamps of darkness. The virtues cannot be opened save with its keys, nor can the glooms be dispelled save with its lamps.
He has protected its inaccessible points and allowed grazing in its pastures. It contains cure for the seeker of cure and sufficiency for the seeker of sufficiency.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and intellectual virtues of Islam according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from the 'Chapter on God and His Vicegerents,' Imam Ali (AS) elevates Islam not merely as a religion but as a comprehensive divine system (manhaj) chosen by Allah, emphasizing its dual nature of apparent knowledge (zahir) and hidden wisdom (batin). This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of Islam as a complete way of life that serves as the ultimate source of spiritual safety (salamah) and honor (karamah), distinguishing the chosen community. The metaphors of keys and lamps underscore its role in guiding believers through both worldly and spiritual darkness, offering healing and sufficiency to those who adhere to its path.
